characters.name: Custodio del Vitral
characters.direction: Ivory layered robes, deep teal stained-glass panels, rose-copper window lattice, ivory hood with teal lining, rosette staff with four teal glass petals. Black faceless hood and bright teal eyes. No blue stars or purple/gold.

characters.name: Soberana de la Orquídea
characters.direction: Living orchid regalia, deep plum petal layers, pearlescent white petals, jade stems, restrained silver dew beads. Keep her face, hairstyle, slender elven anatomy and staff. Orchid crown and flowering staff; no autumn leaves or crimson cape.

characters.name: Farero de las Nubes
characters.direction: Nimbus wears a deep navy and warm coral lighthouse-keeper capelet, cream canvas harness, brass tiny lantern and nautical rope knots. Preserve original dragon body color, wings, horns and baby-dragon face. No aviator goggles or scarf. A small coral beacon crest and lighthouse medallion.

characters.name: Vigía del Basalto
characters.direction: Basalt guardian: rugged black volcanic-stone shoulder plates with dull red magma fissures, dark oxblood woven wraps and bone-white clasp, preserve the original fur, face, anatomy and claws. Costume must remain recognizable on human, transforming and wolf forms. No silver lunar armor or blue leather.

characters.name: Máscara de Porcelana
characters.direction: Shattered porcelain sentinel: matte white ceramic hood plates and half-mask with subtle black ink cracks, charcoal fabric, muted celadon cloth ties, pale ceramic blades. Preserve his shadow-face, luminous eyes, assassin silhouette and weapons. No crimson hood or red daggers.

characters.name: Paladín del Cardenal
characters.direction: Ceremonial cardinal paladin: deep burgundy lacquered armor, ivory engraved pauldrons, warm rose-brass borders, white feather crest, folded wine-colored cape, ivory blade with warm white core. Preserve the original youthful face, hair and knight proportions. No silver-blue lunar uniform and no Aren green-gold.

characters.name: Monarca de la Geoda
characters.direction: Ancient geode sovereign: translucent amethyst crystal crown and shoulder geodes, dark graphite stone bands, pale lavender mineral facets and tiny white quartz inlays. Preserve Nivor original icy dragon anatomy, wing membranes, silhouette and face. No sapphire-silver aurora armor. Purple crystal accents attached securely, no floating pieces.

characters.name: Soberano de la Brasa Blanca
characters.direction: White-ember infernal regalia: bone ceramic segmented armor with soot-black joints, aged red-copper edges, restrained hot white cracks, charcoal cape lined burnt orange, bone blade with white ember core. Preserve Azrak horns, demonic face, stature and sword pose. No obsidian-purple eclipse armor.

characters.name: Maestro de las Mil Tintas
characters.direction: Radiant master of a thousand inks: a richly saturated turquoise tailored coat with coral-red layered inner panels and violet sash, lapis-blue sleeves, bright gold pen-nib buttons and elegant gold edging. Original curled parchment hat silhouette becomes painted turquoise and coral with gilded scroll edges and a violet feather flourish. Vibrant cyan, magenta and amber ribbons flow within his existing four ink tentacles; keep all original quill and book endpoints. Jewel-like colorful details, cheerful mischievous face, polished prestigious Tower-champion look. Preserve Kálamo's original face, brown hair, exact body proportions, pose and inky-paper mage identity. Avoid beige-dominant maps, drab sepia, navy/silver stars, random rainbow armor or more limbs.

characters.name: Maestro de la Clepsidra
characters.direction: Water-clock chronomancer: oxidized verdigris framework, sand-colored layered coat, clear turquoise water-clock vessels built into belt and staff, dark brown gloves and brass hourglass clasps. Preserve Kairós face, age, hair, body proportions and silhouette. No golden gear royal coat, no generic full armor.
